# Vendored from sparkDash

`qualitySuite.js`, `qualityBench.js`, `contextFit.js` and `data/` are copied unchanged (import
paths only) from [sparkDash](https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/sparkDash) (Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE`),
commit in `SOURCE`. The GSM8K and MMLU item samples in `data/` are MIT-licensed upstream.
SparkMan's quality bench (`server/bench/`) generates and scores items with them, so runs stay
comparable item by item with sparkDash's.
